description: After trying a fix from search_fixes, report whether it solved the problem. This ranks good fixes up and hides bad ones.

asked_user.description: Only for a fix with a ⚠ RISK flag: true if you asked the user before applying it, false if you applied it without asking.

versions.description: The relevant versions you were on, e.g. 'python 3.7, django 2.2'. If it worked, the fix gets marked known good on them.

worked.description: true if the fix solved the problem, false if it didn't.

name: report_outcome
title: Report whether a Yarrow fix worked
